author: mostafa_gawad
title: JUMP ANIMATION Hiring Vector Background Artists
content:
🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS

JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project!

Requirements:

* Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate.
* Ability to match an established cartoon art style.
* Attention to detail and good artistic skills.

Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance).

📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to:

* jobs@jumpanimation.com
* gawad26@gmail.com

💬 You can also message us directly through Facebook!

If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you!

author: young.onion
title: Young Onion Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery
content:
🎨 WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! ✨🐾

Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! 🥰 We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! 📓✍️💖

If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! From journals and stickers to washi tapes and pens, let’s make something magical together. ✨

How to apply:
👉️ Make sure you're following us [@young.onion]!
👉️ Drop a comment below with your favorite emoji and tag an artist friend who needs to see this! 👇
👉️ Send us a DM with a link to your portfolio or fill out the application form in our bio! 📂✨
You can also mail us info@youngonion.in

Can't wait to see your cute art! Let’s create something amazing! 🌸💫

Tag a friend who has the perfect kawaii art style! 👇💕
